semantics_approval.scope: independent Legion-native paper research only; not proprietary-platform equivalence

activation.note: entries need approved entry-confirmation thresholds and closed data gaps

trigger_definition.anchor: completed candle where all four native conditions hold
trigger_definition.permitted_entry_range: [pivot, pivot x 1.01]; skip if the trigger candle opens above the range
trigger_definition.initial_stop: per exit variant (consolidation low default); skip if > 8% below entry
trigger_definition.contraction: mean true range of consolidation candles / ATR14 at anchor <= 0.80
trigger_definition.reward_risk: (configured profit target - entry) / (entry - stop) >= 2; for R-multiple targets this is satisfied by construction

label: LEGION_NATIVE - never an exact platform signal

recommended_for_approval.rationale: Bounded initial risk at the technical invalidation; banks half at 2R and moves the stop to breakeven; ATR trail lets a continuation run; 20-session cap limits dead capital. NOT validated by backtest: no point-in-time universe was available.

protections_proposed.failed_breakout: close back below pivot within 3 sessions
protections_proposed.earnings_blackout: exit before a scheduled report inside 7 calendar days
protections_proposed.liquidity_deterioration: spread > 0.50% of mid or 5-day avg volume < 50% of 20-day
protections_proposed.halt: quote state != active -> no action possible; flag
protections_proposed.gap_through_stop: modeled: fill at open, never at the stop price
